questions: Does everyone pay the same fixed amount each round, or can each member pay any amount? Can one member make more than one payment in the same round?
Can a round be collected before every member has paid, or must everyone pay first?
Who picks the collector for each round? Do you choose them yourself at the time, or is there a fixed order set at the start?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round. Yes, sometimes people pay in two parts; all of it counts toward that round.
